messages:
Megan (partnerships): quick pulse — we need to align vendor embargo windows vs marketplace listing for H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. vendor asks for embargo through 2026-11-15 for some partners. can we map that to our marketplace rollout waves?
Raj (hw-eng): noted. which partners specifically? nvidia H200/H100, amd MI300, and Habana Gaudi?
Megan (partnerships): yep. nvidia H200/H100 (partner A), AMD MI300 (partner B), Gaudi (partner C). partner A wants a coordinated announcement + docs + benchmark release. partner B wants an earlier marketplace listing but a soft announce.
Oliver (platform): constraints from infra side: dedicated nodes for H200 need node image + security review — that's ~3 weeks after hardware in lab. if hardware hits lab 2026-10-20, earliest internal canary 2026-11-10.
Nina (marketplace): marketplace listing pipeline needs the vendor-approved logo + certs. typical lead time 7 business days once assets are final. embargo dates matter because we gate public listing.
Alex (solutions): for SI integration partners, they want 2 weeks to test connectors before any public collateral. 
Raj (hw-eng): quick status: vendor A (NVIDIA H200) tentative ship ETA 2026-10-15. vendor B (AMD MI300) ETA 2026-09-30. Gaudi ETA 2026-11-05. those dates may slide +/- 2 weeks.
Megan (partnerships): proposal: carve three marketplace waves to accommodate embargoes and SI testing. draft timeline below — feedback?
Megan (partnerships): ```
Wave 1 (2026-10-10 to 2026-10-31): AMD MI300 soft listing (partner B) - internal canary + SI preview
Wave 2 (2026-11-10 to 2026-11-24): NVIDIA H200 public announcement + marketplace listing + benchmarks (partner A)
Wave 3 (2026-11-28 to 2026-12-12): Gaudi GA listing + partner collateral
Embargo notes: respect partner A embargo until 2026-11-15 for public press; internal docs can circulate to SI partners if NDA in place.
```
Raj (hw-eng): looks ok but swap Wave 1/2 maybe — MI300 lab arrival is earlier so Wave 1 is good. confirm we can do H200 public listing by 11/10 — that’s tight if lab hits 10/15. will need parallel QA.
Oliver (platform): parallel QA possible if we run two staging clusters (H200, MI300) in parallel, but cost ops needs heads-up — estimated 48 GPU-hours per day for 10 days for both clusters.
Nina (marketplace): fine with waves. ask: can we mark Wave 1 as "soft listing (no press)" so it passes compliance but doesn't trigger public notifications?
Megan (partnerships): yes. Wave 1 = soft listing, no press. Wave 2 = coordinated press with partner A. Wave 3 = GA listing.
Alex (solutions): action: I'll assemble SI test checklist and share by 2026-10-01.
Raj (hw-eng): action: I'll confirm lab arrival windows with vendors by 2026-09-25.
Nina (marketplace): action: I'll prep marketplace asset checklist and notify vendor content team. target to collect assets by 2026-10-03.
Megan (partnerships): action: I'll draft the joint announcement calendar and embargo matrix and share a Google sheet. target 2026-09-27.
sync-bot: Reminder: meeting scheduled: HW vendor sync 2026-09-28 16:00 PT (calendar invite sent) :bell:
Oliver (platform): one more ask — add a rollback plan per wave (model fallback to earlier build + traffic split). we should include a canary metric set: p50/p95 latency, token cost, and error rate.
Megan (partnerships): good call. I'll add rollback/playbook notes.
Raj (hw-eng): small technical note: H200 kernels need a new cuDNN compatibility layer — engineering estimate 5 dev-days. if that slips, it pushes Wave 2 by one week. flagging.
Nina (marketplace): can partners provide a "no-press" signed confirmation for soft listing? that will speed legal clearance.
Megan (partnerships): I'll request the confirmation today.
Alex (solutions): if any embargo slips, we should have a standby vendor-agnostic blog post about "platform readiness for next-gen GPUs" that doesn't call out vendors — keeps momentum.
Megan (partnerships): nice idea. please draft rough copy after we lock calendar.
Oliver (platform): noted. ops: tagging @costs team — expect short spike if we run parallel staging.
Megan (partnerships): thanks all. I'll post the spreadsheet and follow up in the sync. tagging @Raj for vendor reconfirm, @Nina for assets, @Alex for SI checklist. :wave:
